cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Use the Proper Title
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll check the top table. My place card needs Chairperson as well as Jo.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you as Jo. That's how I've written all the names.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep Jo first, then. I can work with your style. Just add Chairperson so my standing is clear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There isn't room on this little card.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put a larger card on my plate. You choose the lettering; I'll make room among the cutlery. Jo first, Chairperson beneath. A place setting we can both be pleased with.
